sections.content: As sites grow, repeating header/nav/footer markup in every page becomes unmaintainable. Server-side templating or frontend components solve this: define once, render everywhere.
Templating engines inject data into HTML (loops for lists, conditionals for sections); component frameworks (React, Vue) go further with reusable UI pieces and state.
Key points: DRY applies to markup too, keep templates dumb (logic stays in JS/backend), and shared components guarantee visual consistency.

sections.codeExample:
<!-- template: header rendered on every page -->
<header><nav>...</nav></header>
<main><!-- page content --></main>
